mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the previous 6-month average signals stronger household demand, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 70% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressure and inflationary expectations, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the previous 6-month average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal income (RSAFS) below the previous 6-month average signals weakening household purchasing power, which reduces demand and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above the previous 6-month average signals robust labor market expansion, which increases earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above the previous 6-month average signals stronger residential investment, which boosts construction-related earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.
